about: Guntrad the Pit Boss's lines. 'lines' = his factoid of the day under the portrait (one per calendar day, picked by date): ~half on the vintage cool of cigarettes (his opinion, old Hollywood/noir/Wendover saloon smoke; no health claims, no brands, nothing about getting them), the rest split between male pattern baldness, metal bands and the How to Train Your Dragon movies. Every fact was web-checked when written; if it isn't certain, it doesn't go in. The other sets are short in-fight / table chatter.
lines: The lighter beat the match: 1823 vs. 1826. Fire had a waiting list.
Safety matches: Sweden, 1844. Strike only on the box. Even fire has house rules.
The matchbook got its patent in 1892. Somebody looked at a match and said: needs a jacket.
Collecting matchbooks has a name: phillumeny, coined in 1943. I just call it taste.
Lauren Bacall's first line on film: "Anybody got a match?" Best opening bet ever made.
Bacall was so nervous on day one she kept her chin down to stop shaking. They called it The Look.
Bogart asked Bacall to write her number on a matchbook. Old Hollywood had no group chats.
Now, Voyager, 1942: he lights two cigarettes at once and hands her one. Men copied it for years.
That two-cigarette move wasn't new in 1942. A 1932 picture did it first. Bette Davis was in both.
In 1946 a French critic stuck the label "film noir" on Hollywood crime pictures. Smoke came first.
"Smoke-filled room" comes from the 1920 Republican convention in Chicago. Deals need atmosphere.
"Cigarette" is French for "little cigar." Everything sounds cooler in French.
Smoking jackets showed up in the 1850s to catch the smoke and ash. A jacket with a job.
Smoking's banned on planes, but FAA rules still require an ashtray by every lavatory door.
Wendover: Nevada casino floors may allow smoke, Utah bars across the line can't. Two climates.
West Wendover is Nevada's only official Mountain Time town, since 1999. The ashtrays never adjusted.
Breakfast at Tiffany's, 1961: black dress, long cigarette holder. Two accessories, one legend.
Casablanca won Best Picture. Half its lighting was cigarette smoke, if you ask me.
A smoke ring is a vortex ring: air spinning around a loop. Dolphins blow bubble ones. Show-offs.
Smoke makes a light beam visible. Half the noir alleys you remember are a lighting trick.
A lit cigarette is a period you can see from across the room.
Noir rule: nobody says anything important until a match gets struck.
The pause before a big raise? Old Hollywood filled it with one slow exhale.
Every great saloon line used to end in a curl of smoke. Punctuation, Wendover style.
Strike, flare, exhale: three-beat timing. Silent pictures knew it before sound did.
In a noir, the cigarette tells time: lit means thinking, out means trouble.
Male pattern baldness is androgenetic alopecia. Sounds like a card room in Monaco.
The culprit is DHT. It shrinks scalp follicles until they grow finer, shorter hairs.
The Norwood scale grades baldness in seven stages. I track it like a blind schedule.
Suetonius says Caesar combed his hair forward over the bald spot. The laurel wreath helped.
Minoxidil started as a hypertension pill. The hair growth was a side effect nobody ordered.
Finasteride was approved for prostates in 1992, for hair in 1997. Same pill, second career.
Blaming Mom for the hairline? Half right. One key gene rides the X, but plenty come from Dad.
Losing 50 to 100 hairs a day is normal. I count chips, not hairs.
Hair transplants work because moved follicles keep their old habits. "Donor dominance," 1959.
Black Sabbath formed in Birmingham, England, in 1968. Heavy metal's home game.
Tony Iommi lost two fingertips in a factory, made new ones from a melted soap bottle, kept playing.
To spare those fingertips, Iommi went to lighter strings and later tuned down. Heavy, on purpose.
Judas Priest named themselves after a Bob Dylan song. Folk music: the gateway to leather.
Iron Maiden singer Bruce Dickinson flew the band's own tour jet. Captain on stage and off.
Metallica played all seven continents in one year. Antarctica, 2013: 120-ish people in headphones.
Finland has the most metal bands per capita, about 53 per 100,000 people. Long winters.
Lordi, Finnish monster metal, won Eurovision in 2006. Finland's first win. Masks on the whole time.
Motorhead's "Ace of Spades" came out in 1980. Finally, a metal song about my line of work.
How to Train Your Dragon started as Cressida Cowell's 2003 book. The movie came in 2010.
The 2010 Dragon was directed by Chris Sanders and Dean DeBlois, the pair behind Lilo & Stitch.
In the books, Toothless is a small, ordinary dragon. The movies made him a Night Fury. Big comp.
Toothless's voice is built from elephants, horses, cats and the sound designer's own voice.
Movie Toothless was designed partly after a black panther. Explains the attitude.
Roger Deakins was visual consultant on all three animated Dragon films. Lighting matters.
John Powell's Dragon score got an Oscar nomination. So did the film. Both lost. I know the feeling.
How to Train Your Dragon 2 won the Golden Globe for Best Animated Feature. The sequel took the pot.
The 2025 live-action Dragon kept Gerard Butler as Stoick. Some players never leave the table.
The saloon ashtray has heard three alibis. It believes the piano.
I asked the smoke machine for subtle. It gave me a weather system.
My noir lighting budget is one blind with a bent slat.
Saloons should have a piano that sounds like it owes somebody money.
That ashtray is not a tip jar. We have discussed this.
My cigarette holder has better posture than the entire table.
An empty matchbook is a business card for a place that disappointed you.
I keep a matchbook from every saloon that still lets me finish a story.
Every noir alley has one working lamp. Nobody ever calls maintenance.
The smoke gets a dressing room. I get a hook behind the bar.
My lighter has two settings: dramatic pause and where did I put it.
Casablanca taught me to keep a white jacket nowhere near the chip dip.
A noir detective needs a hat, a shadow, and absolutely no overhead lighting.
Some men collect matchbooks. I collect reasons not to lend them out.
The saloon piano is out of tune. I put it on nights.
The cigarette holder is long so the dramatic pause has somewhere to sit.
Wendover at sunrise looks like the casino forgot to dim the parking lot.
I had a smoke ring appraised. They said the condition was deteriorating.
Noir is when your own shadow asks for a separate room.
I asked for a saloon mirror. They sent one that makes eye contact.
Nobody touches my good ashtray. It came with the building and an argument.
A matchbook fits in a pocket. My opinions require the whole saloon.
The smoke machine and I split tips. It does most of the atmosphere.
A noir monologue should end before the ice in your drink files a complaint.
Someone polished the saloon spittoon. Now everybody thinks it's a trophy.
The ashtray says WELCOME. That was installed before my time.
My hairline requested a transfer. Management has approved it.
A comb-over is a bluff. The remaining hair does not appreciate a crosswind.
I don't have a bald spot. That's where the spotlight lands.
My barber charges by the visit, not by the hair. Sharp businessman.
Wind is a surprise audit of your remaining hair.
My hair has formed a horseshoe. Still waiting for the luck.
The hair on my pillow has started holding meetings without me.
I asked for a little off the top. Apparently my hair took that personally.
A bald head under a desk lamp is technically a second lamp.
Sabbath's debut came out on Friday the 13th. Nobody consulted the superstition committee.
Before Black Sabbath, they were called Earth. Modest claim. Just the entire planet.
Judas Priest won a Grammy for 'Dissident Aggressor.' Good manners weren't on the scorecard.
Metallica's first music video was 'One.' Took them four albums to discover the camera.
Metallica recorded with the San Francisco Symphony. Somebody had to find more chairs.
Derek Riggs created Iron Maiden's Eddie. My portrait budget went to the ashtray.
Maiden launched a beer in 2013. Eddie got the bottle label. Steady work for a corpse.
Motorhead won a Grammy for 'Whiplash' in 2005. Polite applause for a very rude noise.
Lordi put seven studio albums in one 2021 box. Apparently, monsters don't understand 'enough.'
Dragon author Cowell's island holidays had no electricity. That's committing to the atmosphere.
Cowell wrote AND illustrated the Dragon books. I'd have made Toothless do half the paperwork.
David Tennant reads the Dragon audiobooks. Somebody qualified to handle a very long story.
Romans capture Toothless in book three. Even a dragon can't get away from the government.
Hiccup Horrendous Haddock the Third. That's his full name. The sign-in sheet needs another page.
Dragon 2 skips ahead five years. Hiccup grows up; nobody gives the dragons a calendar.
The 2025 Dragon riders sat on six-axis rigs. All that machinery to pretend your chair can bite.
The 2025 Dragon's Gronckle mixes bumblebee motion with bulldog slobber. I've served that regular.
The live-action Dragon arena was built in a car park near Belfast. Parking dispute, now with fire.
